name: LDNIO 36W Car Charger
subtitle: Dual-port charging with voltage display
tagline: Charge two devices on the road
description: LDNIO 36W car charger provides USB-C and USB-A ports for charging two compatible USB-powered devices from a 12–24V vehicle socket. Quick Charge 3.0 support and an LED voltage display add practical charging and vehicle-voltage monitoring functions in a compact black adapter.
story: Made for charging on the road, this adapter can power two compatible USB devices from a standard 12–24V vehicle socket. The separate USB-C and USB-A ports suit different cable types, while Quick Charge 3.0 is available for compatible devices. Its LED display shows vehicle voltage, adding a useful reference during everyday driving. The compact black housing keeps the charger easy to store and use in cars, SUVs, or other vehicles with a compatible socket.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
